1.author: Vladamir(598177550082113536)
1.description: Juggernaut now grants 100% bonus crit chance for Slam, from 25%.

1.author: Vladamir(598177550082113536)
1.description: Improved Rend now increases the critical strike chance of rend by 5/10% instead of reducing its rage cost.

1.author: Vladamir(598177550082113536)
1.description: Execute now does 10% reduced damage in pvp, before it had no pvp modifier.

1.author: Vladamir(598177550082113536)

1.description: Arctic Winds talent now provides reduced 1%/2%/3% damage taken, before they provided 1%/2%/3% reduced chance to be hit. The damage portion of this talent is unchanged.

1.author: Vladamir(598177550082113536)

1.author: Vladamir(598177550082113536)

1.author: Vladamir(598177550082113536)

1.author: Vladamir(598177550082113536)

1.author: Vladamir(598177550082113536)

1.author: Vladamir(598177550082113536)

1.author: Vladamir(598177550082113536)

1.author: Vladamir(598177550082113536)

7.author: Vladamir(598177550082113536)

7.author: Vladamir(598177550082113536)
